title: How to Survive a Psyop
description: A collection of anonymized unpleasant experiences and advice on how to deal with them. Read the four rules, ask ChatGPT for advice, or browse the chapters.
heroLead: Read the survival rules first. Scroll past the rules and there is a ChatGPT analyzer for any individual statement. Understanding the techniques helped me dismiss them. Click Ask ChatGPT and press Enter to accept the prompt and then discuss events conversationally.
